panel.summary: The now-reachable review-panel fix job has no concurrency group, so multiple write-capable autonomous agents can run in parallel on one branch
panel.evidence: agent-iterate-ci.yml:47-49 guards its fixer with `concurrency: agent-iterate-<branch>, cancel-in-progress: true`. The review-panel `fix` job (agent-review-panel.yml:292-304) has no concurrency at any level (the workflow declares none either), so several workflow_run events on the same branch can run concurrent 45-minute agents that each hold contents:write and push to the same ref — racy pushes plus an unbounded parallel spend of the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Until this diff the step never executed, so the gap was inert.
panel.finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml::the now-reachable review-panel fix job has no concurrency group, so multiple write-capable autonomous agents can run in parallel on one branch
